```{mermaid}
%%| echo: false
%%| label: fig-flowchart
%%| fig-width: 8
%%| fig-cap: "Flowchart diagram of the *A day in daylight* use case."
%%{init: {"flowchart": {"diagramPadding": 40}}}%%

flowchart TD

%% ===== Core Setup & Metadata =====
P[Load packages]

PD[Import participant data]
DDEM[Demographic plots]

PD --> DDEM

%% ===== Wearable Import & Cleaning =====
DINFO[Add device_type and file_path]
LIMPORT[Import wearable files into list column]
LCLEAN[Clean per participant:  aggregate, gap handling, filter times, add photoperiod]
LMERGE[Unnest list column into light_data]
LTIME[Deal with local and real time]

PD --> DINFO
DINFO --> LIMPORT
LIMPORT --> LCLEAN
LCLEAN --> LMERGE
LMERGE --> LTIME

%% ===== Overview Branch =====
LOVERVIEW[Overview plots and QC summaries]
LTIME --> LOVERVIEW

%% ===== TAT250 Branch =====
TSEL[Select 22 Sept by local time]
TAT[Compute time above 250 lux]
TPL[TAT250 plots and country boxplots]

LTIME --> TSEL
TSEL --> TAT
TAT --> TPL

%% ===== Event Data Stream =====
ELOAD[Load events data]
EPROC[Process events into time intervals and states]
ETAB[Summaries from events only]

ELOAD --> EPROC
EPROC --> ETAB

%% ===== Merge Events with Light Data =====
EMERGE[Merge event states into light_data]
ENW[Set nonwear and bedtime light to NA]
ESUM[Context summaries, state plots, quick summaries]

LTIME --> EMERGE
EPROC --> EMERGE
EMERGE --> ENW
ENW --> ESUM

%% ===== Circular Time Demo =====
CDEMO[Circular time demonstration]

ELOAD --> CDEMO
```
